js: 'Models as a list beside the detail: the split view at a wide window (status page, a click selects, the arrows move the selection, the handle resizes and keeps its width), the filter popover (?show=), the search (/ and Ctrl+F focus it, Esc clears it, a second Esc goes back to the list), a dirty change on the first local chat model (the accent dot, the save toast, the guard asking when another row is picked, Ctrl+S saving, the saved value read back after a reload, then put back the same way), and the narrow window (one pane at a time, the back button). label: wide: nothing selected shows the status page beside the list
wide: no horizontal overflow
right after the click, before the form has loaded: no save toast and no dialog (an unloaded form has no changes)
an immediate ArrowDown moves on without the unsaved-changes dialog
still no dialog and no toast after the immediate move
a click selects the row: its path, and its form is loaded (before that every field counts as changed, and a key move would ask)
the row is highlighted and the detail has its actions
the list has the focus: the selection takes the accent's tint
ArrowDown moves the selection, and the detail follows
ArrowUp moves it back
